title: Configuration commands acknowledge drafts and follow source notices
description: On the isolated recorded browser, save a synthetic private API key, set its provider active and edit disabled project maxAttempts. Hold original resource notices to distinguish command acknowledgement from canonical source reads. Repair a private registration error and prove Retry rereads only that failure. No provider test, OAuth, import, copilot or native execution.

proofTargets.claim: The real key Save clears its local input after the command reply; provider registration changes only after an original source notice and observed read.
Set Active waits for source notification to change canonical and rendered provider configuration, while retaining an unsaved typed key draft.
After a real registration source error, Retry reads only the failed auth list while healthy config and tiers observations remain unchanged.

Saving a real maxAttempts draft acknowledges that draft without adopting the command's project reply; canonical and rendered project collection changes follow source notices while recovery remains disabled.

prove.intent: Save private configuration through real controls and source notices.

key.intent: Acknowledge the key input and wait for its registration notice.

provider.intent: Update the active provider while preserving an unsaved key draft.

retry.intent: Retry the failed auth read while healthy queries keep their state.

project.intent: Save the disabled project policy and follow its source notice.
